status: Root-reviewed exactfee8region/KKT mathematics and17synthetic tests; isolated from strategy selection. New sourcefreeze required before first savedarray parse.
objective: At every retained firstguard state, diagnose the maximum worst next real wealth over all long-only fully invested after-fee physical holdings. Do not execute it, change a product/action/rule, or use results for candidate/parameter selection.
exploratory_chronology: Post-V2/V2b/V3 diagnostic development, not a jointly prespecified earlier learner. Earlier negative results and all original account choices remain unchanged.

cohort.groups: Every outer_selected/full_selected group in each of the two immutable canonical archives: exactly5outergroups plus1fullgroup per version,12metadata slots including NULL. Original120 IDs once per version/scope; full120 is resubstitution and overlaps outerOOF, never additional independent markets.
cohort.states: Every funded account first_guard_trigger, no favorable cases chosen and no later repeated pending states. Preserve group status and0guard/NULL outcomes. Do not replace a NULL selected learner with a candidate, shadow or alternative tuple.
cohort.omitted_by_declared_scope: Inner candidates, five-repeat stability groups, actual-breach-only states and later pending periods are outside this diagnostic; no inference is made about their physical feasibility.

state_and_information.variables: At period t before the actual next return: nominal holdings x, current CPI C, real wealth R=sum(x)/C, original historical real peak P, original runningMDD, saved original one-step budget floor and original selected rho.
state_and_information.support: Use only saved own-training training_real_gross[t,:,:] with the same calendar t and training IDs. This already includes training joint nominal returns/inflation. No actual next return, realized_real_gross, terminal outcome, forecast probability/eta or post-guard action determines LP coefficients.
state_and_information.extraction: Firstguard identity and saved account arrays are retrospective diagnostic inputs. Whole saved state NPZ members are loaded for indexing, including unused future endpoint columns; only the predecision endpoint is extracted and used. No claim is made that no future account bytes are parsed. Actual-market realization NPZ members are not accessed.
state_and_information.full_training: The full selected diagnostic intentionally retains its existing full120 training support, including its resubstitution exposure. The disjoint outerselected support contains only corresponding own96 training IDs; do not claim full120 is heldout.
state_and_information.checks: Check each firstguard is active/not previously pending, selected_index=-1/support_feasibleFalse, primary13 feasiblepoint count0, exactly one saved guard event, unchanged floor=max((1-L)*P,R-rho*(R-(1-L)*P)) within1e-10*R. Preserve primary interval count and state history without resetting losses.

physical_set.holdings: y_i>=0, no external cash, no borrowing/shorts, all remaining wealth invested after paying the exact destination-buy fee once.
physical_set.exact_funding: sum_i y_i+c*sum_i max(y_i-x_i,0)=V=sum_i x_i. No target-five-percent floor/catalogue constraint is imposed on this physical benchmark; zero-asset boundaries are allowed.
physical_set.mask: Enumerate8closed buy/sell masks in lexicographic(False,True)^3 order. Buy i: y_i>=x_i. Sell i:0<=y_i<=x_i. Equal holdings can belong to both masks, so the union covers every physical y.
physical_set.equality: Within mask B: sum_i (1+c*I_B(i))*y_i=V+c*sum_{i in B} x_i. All8 regions contain hold y=x, so an infeasible solver status is numerical/missing evidence, not a proof of physical failure.
physical_set.maxmin: For every training joint realgross row a_s require a_s dot y/C>=z; maximize z. Four variables(y1,y2,y3,z), with z free. The mathematical full optimum is the maximum of the8regional optima.
physical_set.normalization: The implementation solves equivalent u=y/V and v=z/R: sum_i(1+c*I_B(i))*u_i=1+c*sum_B x_i/V, and a_s dot u>=v. This improves currency/CPI scale invariance without approximating fees.
physical_set.benchmark_only: The benchmark is not a fourth product, live policy proposal, actual fallback action, new liquidity rule or admission change.

numerical_evidence.fixed_solver: scipy.optimize.linprog(method=highs) in exact recorded SciPy runtime; fixed options above, no solver/parameter search or silent retry.
numerical_evidence.primal: Recompute support slack, equality, buy/sell bounds and long-only violations from returned variables. Independently recompute the true positive-part fee, exact self-finance residual, pattern-fee agreement and support minimum versus z. Store both normalized errors and actual nominal self-finance residual.
numerical_evidence.dual: Store all inequality/equality/lower/upper marginals. Using SciPy RHS-sensitivity convention, check inequality/upper<=0 and lower>=0, zero marginals on unbounded limits, stationarity c-Aub.T*mi-Aeq.T*me-ml-mu=0, complementary products and primal-dual objective gap. Save vectors/scalars to permit independent recomputation.
numerical_evidence.acceptance: Each pattern requires status0/successTrue plus every separately computed certificate residual<=1e-8 in normalized current-wealth units. Solver success alone is insufficient. Numerical tolerance differs from the unchanged policy1e-12 event/support conventions and is not extra risk headroom.
numerical_evidence.classification: Any accepted witness whose recomputed worst next real wealth is above the saved floor by more than1e-8*R is numerical_physical_feasible_witness_above_budget. all_eight_numerical_optima_below_budget requires all8accepted and the largest normalized dual-objective-derived maxmin value below floor-1e-8*R. All8accepted with no separated conclusion is numerical_boundary_unresolved. Otherwise record incomplete_solver_or_certificate_evidence or solver_or_certificate_unresolved.
numerical_evidence.no_exact_proof: Dual objective values with finite floating residuals are numerical evidence, not exact rigorous upper bounds. exact_arithmetic_impossibility_proof=False on all outputs. Do not say allphysicalimpossible, futureguaranteed or universally safe from a solver success flag or this numerical classification.
numerical_evidence.uncertainty: Retain every failed/limited/exception pattern and its status/message. Do not delete or replace a region, tune tolerances to a case or rerun to find a favorable label.

interpretation.family_gap: An accepted full-simplex witness above budget at an original firstguard indicates that the earlier declared finite proposal family failed despite a wider physical benchmark having a numerically feasible point at that same state/support. It does not authorize executing that point or prove real-future safety.
interpretation.physical_shortfall: All8numericaloptima below budget support the diagnosis that this same finite empirical support and exact-fee fully invested long-only benchmark cannot meet that current floor within declared numerical evidence. It is not a distribution-free impossibility theorem.
interpretation.limits: Positive but potentially negative-real bill outcomes, empirical support misspecification, future/recursive feasibility and intrayear risk remain unresolved. A one-step benchmark does not price client liabilities, explain causal realized losses or certify admission.

outputs.case_inputs_and_lp_witnesses_json_gz: Every retained input x/C/P/MDD/floor/rho/trainingIDs/current-calendar support once, plus all8LPstatus/solution/primal/dual/certificate witnesses. No original account is edited.

outputs.summary_json: Four separate version/scope rows with original_n120, physical path count, firstguard/LP counts, allclassificationcounts including0 and all8resolvedcount. Do not pool dependent scopes/versions as independent observations.
outputs.manifest_json: Incomplete/failed/complete evidence, full source/input start/end hashes and output hashes. No rawparser, newpolicy, rulechange or exactproof claim.

Validate every parent producer complete/source-input start=end/output6SHA and passed independent audit bound to current manifest/alloutputs/protocol/sourcefreeze.

Receipt-only shortcuts are rejected. parent_closure helper can assemble/hash this metadata closure without np.load.
